description: Elections Commission - Order under Section 38(3) of the (Local Authority Election Ordinance) Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the postponement and rescheduling of local government elections for specific Local Authorities in the Kegalle District. It references election-related ordinances, notifications, nomination processes, and the setting of poll dates, which directly falls under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
